functions.name: PROB
functions.description: Latest probability for a q: question headline or a prop: event contract; uses the API's validated same-as market blend.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Proposition id (search in the Event Risk pane) or question id (q:..., from EXPOSURES).

parameters.name: as_of
parameters.description: Optional date/time: the probability at that moment. Default now.

parameters.name: known_as_of
parameters.description: Optional date/time: only what the graph knew by then. Set equal to as_of for a backtest-safe value.

functions.name: CHANGE
functions.description: 24-hour change in probability of a proposition or a question's headline rung (e.g. 0.05 = +5 points).

parameters.name: known_as_of
parameters.description: Optional date/time: only what the graph knew by then.

functions.name: NAME
functions.description: The question a proposition or question asks, e.g. "Will China blockade Taiwan?"

functions.name: QUESTIONS
functions.description: Spills a table of questions (id, name, headline prob, 24h change, number of rungs, headline rung), biggest 24h movers first.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Optional text the question name must contain, e.g. "taiwan". Empty = all.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: Optional entity id, e.g. "country:TW": only questions involving it.

functions.name: RUNGS
functions.description: Spills a question's ladder: one row per rung (id, name, deadline, threshold, prob, 24h change, status, headline), latest deadline first.

parameters.name: known_as_of
parameters.description: Optional date/time: only what the graph knew by then.

functions.name: PROPOSITIONS
functions.description: Spills a table of propositions (single rungs: id, name, prob, 24h change, close date), biggest 24h movers first.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Optional text the proposition name must contain, e.g. "taiwan". Empty = all.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: Optional entity id, e.g. "country:TW": only propositions involving it.

functions.name: EXPOSURES
functions.description: Spills the questions a security is exposed to (id, name, prob, 24h change, score, impact, direction, risk, path).

parameters.name: ticker
parameters.description: Ticker as in the securities list, e.g. "TSM" or "BRK-B".

functions.name: HISTORY
functions.description: Restated historical probability of a prop: event, or the currently selected headline rung of a q: question. Returns date, probability, and contributing market count.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Optional start date. Default 30 days before end.

functions.name: FIELD
functions.description: Market observation field, e.g. volume (24h), open_interest, observed_at or probability. mkt: IDs select a single source market.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Question q:, event prop:, or source market mkt: ID

functions.name: ASKNOWN
functions.description: Probability observable at the specified date using as_of=known_as_of; no hindsight graph mapping.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Question q:, event prop:, or source market mkt: ID

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Excel date cell or ISO date

functions.name: EVENT
functions.description: Get event metadata such as title, status or venue.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Question q:, event prop:, or source market mkt: ID

functions.name: SEARCH
functions.description: Search event propositions; spills a table with event IDs, contract titles and probabilities.

functions.name: UPDATED
functions.description: Latest underlying market observation timestamp as an Excel serial date/time; format cell as date/time.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Question q:, event prop:, or source market mkt: ID
